task.objective: Keep crews alive through usable crossings, wind shelters, fire supply, rescue and physical foreign freight.
task.natural_termination: All 512 health values reach zero; natural completion takes precedence over the 1024-tick horizon.
task.interaction: Local anchoring changes loaded movement; cargo/tool handoffs, shared shelter fuel, road wear, revived health and recipient-depot deliveries persist.
task.observation_access: Cove geometry is known. Dynamic map view is a radius-two square; the policy sees local integrity/road patches and selected nearest-eight entity rows. Scene visibility uses exactly those entity selections. Off-view events are debug-only.

human_control.camera_recommendation: Focus selected actor or crew, show role/tool and nearby object labels; full-world state is a labelled debug view.
